Name: Nightmare's Retextured Weapons - The Magical Girl Edition
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
Have you ever wanted your weapons to be just a little prettier? Just a little more- fun and magical looking? Maybe even.... magical girly? If not, then this probably isn't the mod for you, XD. If so, then. You're in luck! Because that was [i]exactly[/i] what I wanted for myself, so I made a set of magical girl inspired and themed weapons! And, now with the permission of the modmaker my set is based on, I'm sharing it with you!

This mod completely retextures all the weapons in Stardew Valley (whether they're obtainable or not) to look more magical girly, or to fit in with the general magical girl aesthetic. I made it mostly for my wife and I's own personal use, but since I put so much work into it, I thought I'd share it for others' pleasure! The textures are very heavily based on the ever so lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/287]Nightmare's Weapon Retextures[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/23988239]zcsnightmare[/url]; it is with their permission that I'm sharing my own retextures. I've tried to keep the textures in keeping with the original theme of the weapons; there were a few small edits made to the weapon descriptions though, just to make sure they matched with their new looks.

This mod uses the awesome[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url], so both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] are required for it to work.

This mod is now updated to work with SDV 1.5! [s]I haven't retextured the new weapons yet, aside from the Golden Scythe, but that's in the works![/s] All new weapons have been retextured!


[b]Installation:[/b]
[b]1. [/b]Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2. [/b]Unzip the '[CP] Nightmare's Weapons Magical Girl Edition' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new weapons!
